subject: Pilot credit uplift & escrow guardrails for SpectraHealth RFP
messages:
From: Julian Park <julian.park@spectrahealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@spectrahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP pilot: request for additional credits + confidentiality note

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile and model routing looks promising for our clinical triage use case. Procurement asked me to confirm if Redwood can provide an uplifted pilot allocation for the RFP bake-off: specifically, an additional 250k tokens of compute credits (on top of the standard pilot) and a 60-day extension to the sandbox window. Two constraints from our side:

- We need a short confidentiality carveout to permit side-by-side comparisons with a named incumbent within our evaluation materials. This is a procurement/legal ask, not a public NDA change.
- We require usage telemetry for the specific pilot project (aggregated) and an operations contact for sampling logs if we need to validate throughput under burst.

Attached are the RFP requirements for reference. Can you confirm whether this is feasible and what the approved guardrails would be (expiry, escrow, consumption caps)?

Appreciate a quick turn so we can include the exact pilot terms in the scoring rubric.

Best,
Julian Park
CTO, SpectraHealth
[Attachment: SPECTRA_RFP_REQUIREMENTS.pdf (pdf, 310KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Julian Park <julian.park@spectrahealth.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@spectrahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP pilot: request for additional credits + confidentiality note

Hi Julian — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP doc. Short answer: yes, we can support an uplift and the telemetry you describe. A few clarifying points and proposed guardrails so procurement can score the offer: 

- Credits: we can commit an extra 250,000 token-equivalent pilot allocation for the bake-off, delivered as a timebound voucher tied to DEAL-2028-9531. Tokens expire 90 days after activation unless otherwise agreed.
- Extension: we can extend the sandbox window by 60 days from the original start date.
- Confidentiality carveout: we can add a narrow clause permitting side-by-side comparison within SpectraHealth’s evaluation team for the RFP; does not grant any public benchmarking rights. Our legal team prefers a one-paragraph carveout in the pilot agreement.
- Escrow / consumption caps: we require a soft daily consumption cap (suggested 40k tokens/day) to protect capacity. If SpectraHealth expects sudden spikes above that, we’ll need to agree a surge policy to avoid throttling.
- Telemetry: we can provide aggregated usage dashboards and an operations contact for sampling redacted logs under a Data Access Addendum.

I’m looping Ben (sales ops) and Lauren (solutions) to confirm operational fit and to attach the pilot-subsidy agreement for signatures. If that looks good, we’ll send a DocuSign with the one-paragraph carveout and the activation voucher.

Next steps: 
1) Confirm acceptance of the token expiry (90 days) or propose an alternate window
2) Procurement to confirm the exact names for the confidentiality carveout
3) We’ll prepare the DocuSign and voucher code once Ben confirms approvals

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
min a_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: pilot-subsidy-agreement_v2.docx (docx, 42KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: RFP pilot: request for additional credits + confidentiality note

Mina / Lauren — reviewed the RFP in HubSpot and the uplift ask. Finance has approved the 250k token uplift under these commercial guardrails: 

- Voucher: single-use voucher tied to DEAL-2028-9531, activates on signature + activation email, expires 90 days after activation.
- Daily cap: soft cap 40k tokens/day, with a one-time surge allowance of 120k tokens in a 48-hour window if SpectraHealth runs a scheduled benchmark (we require a 72-hour notice). Surges beyond that will be charged at our standard test-rate.
- Escrow: we will not place funds in escrow; instead we will require a signed pilot-subsidy agreement and a countersigned confidentiality carveout. If procurement insists on escrow, legal wants an explanation of what escrow would protect (we usually avoid escrow for pilots).
- Telemetry: ops will provide aggregated dashboards and one sampling session of logs (redacted PII) under a Data Access Addendum.

I approve sending DocuSign with the one-paragraph carveout and the voucher. Please include the HubSpot deal link in the DocuSign envelope and a short line item describing the surge process.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Approved: SpectraHealth pilot uplift, voucher + next steps

Julian / Elena — good news: we’ve approved the uplift and documented the guardrails. Summary below (formal agreement and DocuSign to follow):

What Redwood will provide:
- One voucher for 250,000 token-equivalent pilot credits tied to DEAL-2028-9531; voucher will be delivered in the DocuSign envelope and is single-use.
- Sandbox extension of 60 days from original start date.
- Aggregated usage dashboards and one redacted log sampling session (ops contact: ops-oncall@redwood.com).

Key guardrails (please review):
- Voucher activation: voucher activates when the DocuSign is fully signed; tokens expire 90 days after activation.
- Daily soft cap: 40k tokens/day. Scheduled benchmark surge allowance: 120k tokens in any 48-hour window with 72-hour advance notice.
- Confidentiality carveout: one-paragraph clause allowed for internal side-by-side evaluation with named incumbent(s). No public benchmarking rights granted. Please provide the list of named competitors you plan to include so legal can populate the clause.
- Escrow: Redwood will not accept escrow for pilot credits. If procurement requires escrow, provide a procurement rationale and we’ll escalate to legal for an exception request.

Attachments & links: DocuSign to follow with the pilot-subsidy agreement and the carveout paragraph. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9531. DocuSign preview link: https://www.docusign.com/link/EXAMPLE-abcdef123456

If that aligns, I’ll send the DocuSign envelope today. Once signed I’ll drop the voucher code and the onboarding runbook.

Thanks,
